basis: User-authorized bounded qualification and no-apparent-slowdown default rule. Passing correctness is separate from default promotion. Clear measured counterexamples retain opt-in defaults; no claim of host-qualified performance.

decisions.reason: Short raw chains +10.5% execution / +20.9% including GC; hot raw chains faster execution but +8.0% including GC.
Changing-input loop +14.1% execution / +13.6% including GC; invariant loop faster.
Hot closures faster; closure-only confirmation has +10.3% single-use GC-inclusive time and +8.7% ordinary-collection process time. Combined closure/literal controls also crossed the rule.
Hot numeric case +8.2% execution and +6.0% process time; short case +7.8% execution.
Existing defaults: binding application -7.7% execution, -9.5% including GC, -22.8% process time; semantic and lifetime checks remain passed.

next_work: Any default promotion needs an implementation/admission improvement, rather than rerunning this qualification until a favorable result appears. Further optimization development is not part of this bounded run.
